name: Weird Girl Science
source:
As part of the shady insurance policy that has kept you and your girlfriend healthy for many years, you signed yourself up for a slim chance to be taken away for unethical experiments in an unknown facility. It was good while it lasted, but now your number is up. 

You're now the guinea pig for a mad scientist named Dr. Joy, trapped in a facility controlled by an evil supercomputer and have to do whatever it takes to survive and (hopefully) get out of there. If you can withstand having your flesh defiled in the name of science, you might eventually find a way out... and maybe... even find "love"??

[From [url=https://screenslave.itch.io/weird-girl-science]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为多年来让你和你女朋友保持健康的不正当保险的一部分，你为自己报名了一个微乎其微的机会，被带去一个未知的设施进行不道德的实验。持续的时候很好，但现在你的号码已经增加了。

你现在是一位名叫乔伊博士的疯狂科学家的小白鼠，被困在一个由邪恶超级计算机控制的设施中，必须不惜一切代价才能生存并（希望）离开那里。如果你能忍受以科学的名义玷污你的肉体，你最终可能会找到出路……也许……甚至找到“爱”？

[来自[url=https://screenslave.itch.io/weird-girl-science]itch.io[/url]]
